name: The True Masters
label: Quest
description: The True Masters: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Solomon paints a dreary picture. Still, we cannot afford to send our thinly spread troops to the aid of Lakeshire on speculation. I will need proof of these claims before I can act.
Speak with Lady Prestor, friend. She is a learned woman and knows much of dragons and dragonkin. She may be able to shed some light on this situation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: While I respect Lady Prestor's stance, I believe that there is a solution to this dilemma that may put all of our concerns to rest.
